'''Isebaille Tobanyi''' was an [[Aes Sedai]].

==History==
[[Faile]] mentions [[Jestian Redhill]], Isebaille Tobanyi and [[Mashera Donavelle]] as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the [[White Tower]] told them to do.
It is said that Isebaille delivered the throne of Arad Doman and brothers that she loved to their enemies upon command from the White Tower.{{ref/book|7|6}}
